SEARCH
Package neqsim.util

Class NeqSimVersion

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NeqSimVersion
public final class NeqSimVersion extends Object
Resolves the version of the running NeqSim library.

Lookup order:

  1. the neqsim.version system property, when set;
  2. the Implementation-Version entry of the JAR manifest;
  3. the Maven metadata (META-INF/maven/com.equinor.neqsim/neqsim/pom.properties) packaged in released JARs, whose manifests carry no implementation version;
  4. "development" for an unpackaged classpath such as target/classes.
